missed.rationale: "Meter reading submitted" is the portal's English name for the customer self-reading that the reading process waits for as "Zählerstand übermittelt"; the message names differ, so only the semantic tier finds it. The catch lies inside an embedded subprocess, which is fine: only start and end events there are excluded.
"Tariff change requested" and "Tarifwechsel beantragt" are the same request, English in the portal and German in sales; different message names.
"Instalment change requested" is the English portal event for "Abschlagsaenderung gewuenscht" in the C7 instalment process; different message names.
"Invoice published" (e-invoice platform, English) and "Rechnung bereitgestellt" are the same event; different message names, so only the semantic tier finds it.

Handover from grid service to metering - after the installer's completion notice the grid side orders the first meter, and the meter setting process starts at "Hausanschluss fertiggestellt". Labels differ; agents only.
